drop: Drop an RTF file here to convert it to PDF
privacy: Your document stays in this browser. No uploads or remote document resources.
invalid: Choose a readable RTF document. The file may be damaged, encrypted, or use an unsupported format.
failed: The PDF could not be created. No incomplete file is available for download.
unsupported: This document contains unsupported content, picture formats, or field instructions. Save a self-contained copy with embedded PNG or JPEG pictures and try again.
resource: The browser could not allocate enough resources to render this document. Close other tabs or try another device.
engineUnavailable: The conversion engine could not start. Reload the page, close other tabs, or try another current browser.
fidelity: The engine renders page size, orientation, headers, footers, page breaks, tables, and supported embedded PNG/JPEG pictures. Supported text remains selectable; OCR is not added.
limitations: Embedded objects, external resources, unsupported picture formats, and unsupported field instructions are rejected. Comments, macros, and digital signatures are not preserved or verified. Form controls are flattened to their printed appearance.
protected: Password-protected documents are not supported. Save an unencrypted copy in your word processor and try again.
layoutNotice: Fonts are substituted when unavailable. Complex layouts, line breaks, and pagination can differ from the original application. Check every page in the PDF preview before downloading.
engineDownload: The first conversion downloads about 90 MB of engine and font files, which your browser may cache. Your document is never uploaded.
